summary: Implemented the engine-free savers and plot function and rewired the three handlers to delegate. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver with save, save_batch, finalize, overwrite-false merge) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver with save, save_batch, file-name helper); monai/data/nifti_writer.py default dtype now np.float32; monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py gains plot_2d_or_3d_image; SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver (with engine-accepting finalize wrapper), and TensorBoardImageHandler (new index parameter) are thin adapters; examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py, unet_evaluation_dict.py and tests/integration_sliding_window.py use output_dir. New tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; test_handler_classification_saver.py passes filename. Verification: static reading only. No tests or flake8 were run, per instructions, and nothing is committed. A grep found no lines over 120 characters in changed files and no stale output_path references. Ignite 0.3.0 attach behavior is unverified.
